chapter_summary: A brief encounter returns as a memory whose details keep changing. Debolina accepts memory as an imperfect witness, not a license to claim another person's story.

spatality.place: the lane below the scaffold, where a stranger passed hours earlier
spatality.season: the same dry evening, remembered later
spatality.route: no movement — the poem stays in the place of remembering
spatality.texture: warm dust remembered, a scent that memory keeps altering

poetic_parameters.movement: Confessionalism — the personal record examined, here the ethics of remembering another body.
writing_skills: deliberate correction of a remembered detail within the poem
a close that gives the stranger back his privacy
poetic_parameters.image_seed: a remembered scent that no longer matches the lane it came from
poetic_parameters.volta: from trusting memory to catching it in the act of improving a stranger
poetic_parameters.sonic_texture: the soft repeated r of remember, altered, stranger, wearing the memory down
poetic_parameters.line_gesture: winding lines with parenthetical corrections, ending on a bare short line
poetic_parameters.variety_note: Chapter three met the stranger in the present; this poem meets him again in memory and finds the account compromised.
poetic_parameters.metaphor_family: rewriting, revision, and the hand that edits a person into an image
poetic_parameters.address: the stranger, then the self, in reproach
poetic_parameters.closing_move: a withdrawal of the remembered detail, leaving the lane empty again
